notes.title: Sale for Chinese Language Support (10/31/2024-11/14/2024)
notes.content:
In conjunction with the Chinese language support of this title, we have set up the following sale.
(The sale is valid regardless of the language setting.)

Period: 10/31/2024 (Thu) - 11/14/2024 (Thu)
Discount rate: 30%.

We understand that this is a time when both mind and body tend to be unstable.
We would be happy if we could relieve your raw distress as much as possible.

notes.title: 10/31/2024 Update for Chinese Language Support
notes.content:
An update has been distributed. The changes are as follows

Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) language support

Translation was done by @Tokiko_Flankoi. Thank you very much.
We hope that this update will be an opportunity to deliver this game to a wider audience.

notes.title: 2024/2/5 Patch Information
notes.content:
A patch has been released today.

This patch fixes the following problems reported by the community.

When the language setting of the PC is not set to "Japanese," text is not displayed.

If you have encountered this problem, please apply the patch and try again.

If the problem still recurs, there is a possibility that a "save data" has been generated that prevents the text from being displayed. Please try deleting the following files

Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\veryOK\Aoarashi\savedata

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your patience.
